summary: Frontend testing of Audio System UI for Tavern Crafting RPG. Verified AudioProvider, settings page, volume controls, back navigation, and code structure for all audio requirements.

ui_bugs.issue: When navigating directly to /settings URL without prior history, back button shows dev warning 'GO_BACK not handled by any navigator' and does not navigate away. Works correctly when accessed from main menu.

action_items: Back button in settings should gracefully handle the case of no navigation history (e.g., router.canGoBack() check, fallback to router.replace('/'))
critical_code_review_comments: AudioEngine singleton pattern correctly handles hot-reload via globalThis key
getMusicTheme() pure function correctly maps: kitchen→kitchen, garden→garden, dormitory+morning→dormitory-morning, dormitory+evening→dormitory-evening
A/B crossfade with 3000ms duration implemented with 30-step interval — race-safe via crossfadeRequestId
Preload before crossfade: _pollForLoad polls isLoaded every 100ms (max 50 attempts = 5s timeout)
AudioProvider wraps root layout in _layout.tsx correctly
settings.tsx reads musicVolume/sfxVolume from AudioProvider context and persists to AsyncStorage 'game_settings' key
dormitory.tsx crossfadeTo getMusicTheme('dormitory', morning/evening) based on timeOfDay
playMorningBirdsOnce() in dormitory: maxDurationMs=7000, duckMusic(0.75, 500), restores after 7s
Sleep transition: owl SFX on sleep confirm, crossfade to morning after fade-to-black, birds on morning reveal
All 4 theme audio files exist: Kitchen-Theme.mp3, Garden-Theme.mp3, Room-Morning-Theme.mp3, Room-Evening-Theme.mp3
No theme restart on re-renders due to empty dep array in useEffect (no dependency on audioManager)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Audio system UI fully verified. All testIDs present and working. Volume buttons change display values and persist via AudioEngine → AudioProvider → AsyncStorage. Back button minor issue: no graceful fallback when no navigation history exists. All audio files confirmed present. Code review shows no critical issues.
rca_of_issue: Back button issue: router.back() in Expo Router requires navigation history. When user navigates directly to /settings URL, there's no prior screen in history stack. Fix: add canGoBack() check with fallback to router.replace('/').
